journey.name: custom fee replaces preset in send
journey.description: Verifies that the custom fee screen of an on-chain send shows the preset rate as selected, so the first number pad key replaces it instead of appending to it. Reported in the public Bitkit Telegram group. Preconditions: a synced regtest wallet with at least 30,000 confirmed sats in Savings.

actions.action: Start an on-chain send of 5,000 sats from Savings to a fresh regtest address and reach the confirmation screen
Open the speed picker by tapping the Speed and Fee value, then tap Custom (id "fee_CUSTOM_button")
On the custom fee screen, verify the amount shows the preset rate with a highlighted background
Tap 7 (id "N7") and verify the amount reads 7 with no highlight, not the preset with 7 appended
Tap 0 (id "N0") and verify the amount reads 70
